exposure: immunosuppressive therapy (plasmapheresis, immunoglobulins, dexamethasone, rituximab, cyclophosphamide, cyclosporine, sirolimus, bortezomib, mycophenolate mofetil)
cohort: A 35-year-old Caucasian woman with acquired factor V inhibitor (AFVI).
finding: This case demonstrates that AFVI patients may undergo spontaneous remission even after multiple courses of ineffective immunosuppressive protocols.
mod_finding: Pregnancy was associated with improvement of AFVI.
